mapper.sql: select q.report_id, q.batch_id, b.batch_no, q.inspection_date, q.inspector, q.alcohol, q.total_sugar, q.volatile_acid, q.sulfite, q.is_qualified, q.report_url, q.remarks, q.del_flag, q.create_by, q.create_time, q.update_by, q.update_time from trace_quality_report q left join trace_batch b on b.batch_id = q.batch_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from trace_quality_report where batch_id = #{batchId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into trace_quality_report ( batch_id, inspection_date, inspector, alcohol, total_sugar, volatile_acid, sulfite, is_qualified, report_url, remarks, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{batchId}, #{inspectionDate}, #{inspector}, #{alcohol}, #{totalSugar}, #{volatileAcid}, #{sulfite}, #{isQualified}, #{reportUrl}, #{remarks}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
